lead: Picks the model in the input area: a compact trigger (icon + current model name + caret) that opens a list of models with descriptions and badges, optionally grouped. Keyboard support and type-ahead come from Base UI's Select, and the list reuses the Select theme styles.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: With `group`, models are shown in groups: models of the same group are gathered together under the group name.

composer.title: In a Composer
composer.description: Put it in `Composer.ToolbarStart`; the list opens upward by default.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.trigger: The trigger (a compact button); `data-popup-open` while the list is open
styling.triggerParts: The model name, icon and caret in the trigger
styling.item: The extra parts of a list item (the list itself reuses Select's slots: `select` / `select-item` / `select-group` …; the popup has `data-model-picker`)
